blurb: Studio 88 Swing offers dance classes and events focused on Swing dance styles including Lindy Hop, Charleston, Balboa, and West Coast Swing. They provide group classes, corporate group dance courses, and studio rentals. The studio is located in Montreal and emphasizes accessibility, inclusivity, and high-quality instruction.
